findings.quote: Artificial intelligence is transforming our economies, our societies, and the way we approach development.
findings.rationale: Argues for widely shared AI as an accelerator of development and reduced inequality, citing the Secretary-General.

findings.quote: Last year, at the initiative of Tajikistan, the General Assembly adopted the resolution on the role of artificial intelligence in creating new opportunities for sustainable development in Central Asia.
findings.rationale: Reports Tajik-sponsored UN AI development and safe/trustworthy AI day initiatives, emphasizing innovation serving humanity; these are speech claims, not external verification of adoption details.
